static_traits.name: Chen Jie
static_traits.family_status: Father worked in drywall construction, Mother is a registered Nurse (RN)
static_traits.social_status: Relationships with colleagues growing tense due to frequently seeking reassurance about Work security; has one close friend to confide in, but has not yet discussed the WorkFear with them
static_traits.medical_history: Has not had similar psychological problems before, has not received psychotherapy; no significant physical illness
static_traits.language_features: Clear expression, relatively high cooperation; tone rather negative, repeatedly emphasizing worries; tending to focus on negative feedback and finding it hard to accept positive information; has a tendency to seek reassurance

basic_info.main_problem: I have a persistent Fear that my boss will eventually fire me, even though I perform Good in my Technician role. This Fear of losing Work is causing significant pressure and Anxiety.
basic_info.core_demands: The fear of losing my job has begun to affect my work performance and overall physical and mental state, so I now seek counseling to relieve this fear and improve performance and well-being.
growth_experiences: A few months after joining, a few small mistakes started generating Fear of being fired; recent company restructuring layoffs significantly intensified this Fear. Since then, it is triggered almost daily when receiving supervisor feedback or at company meetings, gradually affecting sleep, diet and Work performance.
Family background: Father is a drywall construction worker, Mother is a registered Nurse; no major physical or psychological illness history reported yet, has not received psychotherapy.

core_beliefs: I am not safe at Work and will be fired sooner or later
Small mistakes determine my worth and whether I stay

special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If the company starts layoffs, I will eventually be laid off too
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Staying highly vigilant, constantly worrying and trying self-comfort to ease it, but the effect is brief
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I will be the next one laid off

special_situations.conditional_assumptions: Any negative opinion means I am not competent and will be fired
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Only focuses on the negative parts, ignores positive evaluations; doubles work to seek recognition
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: They are not satisfied with me; this feedback is paving the way for firing

special_situations.event: A few small mistakes early in the new job
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I make a mistake, it shows I am not qualified and will be fired sooner or later
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Repeatedly recalls mistakes to stay alert to myself, and seeks positive feedback from colleagues to comfort myself
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: Those mistakes will be remembered and become the reason to fire me

special_situations.conditional_assumptions: Positive feedback is not reliable and does not show I am safe
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Belittling or denying positive information, continuing to seek more reassurance
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: These kind words do not count; I may still be fired

core_conflict.wish: Longs for a stable, safe and recognized work position
core_conflict.fear: Fearing Being rejected/abandoned (being fired), losing worth and livelihood
defense_goal: Reducing uncertainty and avoiding sudden layoffs through constant vigilance and seeking reassurance

object_relations.self_representation: An unstable subordinate who may be eliminated at any time
object_relations.object_representation: A picky, controlling superior/organization that may lay people off at any time

object_relations.self_representation: The person who needs others' affirmation to feel safe
object_relations.object_representation: Colleagues who can provide brief comfort but are not reliable

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When talking about company layoffs, reviewing small mistakes, or receiving constructive feedback from a supervisor
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Treating constructive feedback as a negative omen, understanding uncertainty as approaching danger
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Repeatedly listing past small mistakes and company restructuring as grounds for fear in a calm, rational tone, weakening positive evidence, emphasizing 'risk', and demanding more guarantees.

manifestations: Unwilling to share the WorkFear with close friends lest it seem like complaining or being unable to handle it myself
Relationships with colleagues are strained by seeking reassurance, subjectively feeling alienated from others
outcomes: Decline in work performance and workplace Increased stress

contact_model.definition: The individual ignores or avoids a stimulus from the internal or external environment, deliberately avoiding direct contact
manifestations: In feedback situations, bypasses the positive content and quickly turns to negative possibilities or layoff risks
Hard to stay with positive evaluations; quickly returns to worry topics

contact_model.definition: The individual has poor self-Reflection and introspection ability, including Excessive self-restriction and self-reproach, overly cautious about contact
manifestations: Worrying about appearing to complain or being unable to handle problems myself, thus not seeking help from friends
Self-denial after frequently seeking reassurance among colleagues, further limiting expression and help-seeking

positive_force: Overall job performance Good, able to receive constructive and positive feedback from supervisors and colleagues
Willing to try challenging my thinking and accept reality testing (open attitude toward the counseling plan)
Having a close friend who can provide potential support
negative_force: Cognitive tendencies of catastrophizing, predicting the future, mental filtering and negating positive information
Highly sensitive to uncertainty with Persistent anxiety
Excessive reassurance-seeking leading to tense colleague Relationships
Sleep and diet affected,Decline in work performance
Not yet proactively using existing Social support (has not yet discussed this issue with friends)

target_behavior.behavior: Work-related Persistent anxiety and strong Fear of being fired
antecedent: Receiving constructive feedback from a supervisor
Company meetings or information related to restructuring/layoffs
Recalling a few small mistakes from early employment
target_behavior.core_reason: Catastrophizing early small mistakes and the company layoff event, overgeneralizing, and predicting the worst future outcomes, forming the core belief 'will be fired sooner or later'
target_behavior.function: Avoiding uncertainty and perceived danger, seeking external reassurance to temporarily ease Anxiety
target_behavior.consequence: Decline in work performance, Tense relationships with colleagues, Sleep and diet affected, almost daily repeated worry
